name: Brian Arfi Faridhi
bio: Brian is a product leader with 16+ years building and scaling products across platform, AI and blockchain. He has driven growth at Tokopedia and Hijra, founded his own venture, and now works as a fractional Head of Product helping founders reach product-market fit.
He hosts the BroBri podcast and community, where he interviews the product builders featured throughout this index.
